body.name: Mermaid Scale
body.description: This scale, taken from the body of a dead mermaid, shimmers beautifully in many colors when it catches the light. Yet the cold aura clinging to it leaves an unsettling chill in the air.

body.name: Mermaid's Tear
body.description: This teardrop-shaped, milky-white crystal is usually translucent but turns clear underwater. Some claim it can be taken from a living mermaid, yet most are found on the dead.
